title: Staid
summary: STAID, pret, and participle passive of stay; so written for stayed. 1. adjective [from stay, to stop.] Sober; grave; steady; composed; regular; not wild, volatile, flighty or fanciful; as staid wisdom

inlines.v: STAID, pret, and participle passive of stay; so written for stayed. 1. adjective [from stay, to stop.] Sober; grave; steady; composed; regular; not wild, volatile, flighty or fanciful; as staid wisdom. To ride out with staid guides.
